skeleton.matrixLayout: column-major arrays; column vectors; parentWorld * local; metres
skeleton.serializedMotionPositions: ball, renderedBall.p, simHandTarget, bones.joint/tip are pitch coordinates; bones.world matrices are render world coordinates.
skeleton.rootBasis: columns right=[-sin(f),0,-cos(f)], up=[0,1,0], forward=[cos(f),0,-sin(f)], translation=[simX,dz,-simY]; f radians
skeleton.jointRotationConvention: pose [pitch,yaw,roll] degrees; M4.euler = Ry * Rx * Rz; local=T(offset)*rotation
skeleton.bindRest: zero local rotations and summed serialized offsets
skeleton.glbDefaultConstructionPose: upper arms +/-0.12 rad Z, forearms -0.13 rad X, hands +0.03 rad X; all else zero
skeleton.skinRuleGLB: sum(weight * jointWorld * inverseBind * POSITION), with mesh/root transforms applied exactly once
skeleton.skinWeights: JOINTS_0 uint16 VEC4; WEIGHTS_0 float32 VEC4; max 3 nonzero; no morph targets or facial bones

externalDependencies.bakedGLB: Any conformant glTF 2.0 skinned-mesh loader plus approved C shader/material adapter; no Node/Python at shipped runtime required.
externalDependencies.proceduralNode: Node CommonJS plus @napi-rs/canvas 0.1.100 observed; CODEX_PRIMARY_RUNTIME_NODE_MODULES points at directory containing package. Kit uses system generic serif/sans fonts, so regeneration on another font stack is not promised byte-identical.
externalDependencies.headGeneratorPython: Python 3 standard library only; existing Anchor runtime mesh is required. No Blender required for current head generation/export closure.
externalDependencies.browserGates: puppeteer-core + Chrome + existing complete host page; included scripts hard-code macOS Chrome path; adapt launcher configuration only on other OS.
externalDependencies.offlineEnvironment: @napi-rs/canvas; only directly loaded environment inputs included. Full sprite/page assets and engine intentionally omitted.
